references.text: The first census of the tribe of Reuben showed 46,500 men, which can be compared with the number 43,730 in this second census, indicating a decrease in the size of the tribe.
Reuben's camp and their numbers are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement in the wilderness.
The sons of Reuben—Hanok, Pallu, Hesron, and Karmi—are listed here; these are the same clans that form the basis for the census in Numbers 26.
The sons of Reuben are listed here with the same names that form the basis for the clans in the census.
Reuben's birth as Jacob's firstborn son, the ancestor of the Reubenites who are counted here.
1 Chronicles provides further information about Reuben's lineage and why he lost his birthright.
